name: Le Meurice
insider_take: Le Meurice isn't just a hotel—it's a living piece of Parisian history where Salvador Dalí lived for 30 years and where royalty still chooses to stay when visiting the City of Light.
whats_special: This palace hotel sits directly across from the Tuileries Garden with unobstructed views of the Louvre. The Restaurant Le Meurice Alain Ducasse holds two Michelin stars, and the hotel's 18th-century décor was personally overseen by Philippe Starck. Every suite features original antiques and many boast private terraces overlooking Paris's most iconic landmarks.
pro_tip: Book the Belle Etoile Suite—it's the only hotel penthouse in Paris with a 360-degree terrace offering views of the Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, and Sacré-Cœur simultaneously.
dont_miss: The hotel's Winter Garden breakfast room with its stunning glass ceiling, and afternoon tea in Bar 228—consistently ranked among the world's best hotel bars. Step outside and you're literally 30 seconds from the Louvre's main entrance and a 2-minute walk to Place Vendôme's luxury boutiques.
pros: Prime location facing Tuileries Garden with stunning views
Luxurious palace hotel with opulent 18th-century French decor
Michelin-starred dining and world-class spa facilities
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Rich history hosting royalty and celebrities since 1835
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
